# Newsletter (Channel)

## Follow / Unfollow

```ts
await sock.newsletterFollow('120363...@newsletter')
await sock.newsletterUnfollow('120363...@newsletter')
```

## Create

```ts
const ch = await sock.newsletterCreate('Channel Name', 'Description')
```

## Metadata

```ts
const meta = await sock.newsletterMetadata('invite', 'INVITE_CODE')
console.log(meta.name, meta.subscribers)
```

## Update

```ts
await sock.newsletterUpdateName('120363...@newsletter', 'New Name')
await sock.newsletterUpdateDescription('120363...@newsletter', 'New description')
await sock.newsletterUpdatePicture('120363...@newsletter', { url: './photo.jpg' })
```

## Mute / React

```ts
await sock.newsletterMute('120363...@newsletter')
await sock.newsletterUnmute('120363...@newsletter')
await sock.newsletterReactMessage('120363...@newsletter', 'msg_id', 'fire')
```
